Definition: spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively)
BiblicalUsage: Yâtsûwa means a spread, a bed, or an extension built against a wall. Reuben lost his birthright because he defiled his father's bed, and Solomon built chambers round about the walls of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a bed defiled can cost a birthright, and the chambers of the temple were built to hold the holy things.
